items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielborken – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: This is a formally served letter (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO): the deemed-delivery rule for ordinary authority post does not apply. The attached delivery certificate shows the envelope was handed over ('Zugestellt ... 24.11.2026') on 2026-11-24, so that is the actual date of service. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted; the two-week (14-day) Einspruchsfrist runs from 2026-11-25 and ends two weeks later, on 2026-12-08 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 2026-12-08 is a Tuesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday in NW, so no shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG analog, § 43 StPO/§ 110 OWiG). The objection must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount after Rechtskraft
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter instructs payment only after the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final), i.e. only if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above (ending 2026-12-08). Assuming no objection is lodged, the decision becomes final with the expiry of that period, i.e. at the end of 2026-12-08. Applying the same counting convention (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the triggering event is not counted), the two-week payment window runs from 2026-12-09 and ends on 2026-12-22 (a Tuesday, a regular working day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed). If an Einspruch is filed, this payment obligation does not arise on this timeline and a new date would follow any later decision.

warnings: The place and sender names used throughout the letter (Kreis 'Beispielborken', 'Mustermünster', the recipient 'Johanna Beispielacker', the e‑mail domain ending '.example') are the German words for 'example'/'sample', so this reads like a template or test document rather than a genuine Bußgeldbescheid from a real Kreis — verify the authority's real identity, Aktenzeichen and bank details through an independent channel (e.g. the Kreis's official website or phone number) before paying anything or relying on these dates.

The IBAN printed for payment (DE52 4005 0000 0004 6325 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid format does not confirm who owns the account; confirm it matches the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory name check before transferring any money.

The payment deadline of two weeks is explicitly conditional on the fine becoming final (Rechtskraft), i.e. on no Einspruch being filed within the 2026-12-08 deadline; if an Einspruch is filed, do not pay by 2026-12-22 — a new timeline would apply instead.
